title: valerianella locusta subsp. lusitanica
intro: Valerianella locusta subsp. lusitanica, commonly known as the Iberian corn salad or Iberian land cress, is a subspecies of the Valerianella locusta plant, which is a type of leafy green vegetable belonging to the Valerianaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its ability to support digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Valerianella locusta subsp. lusitanica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and antiseptic properties.
